definitions.gloss: to ask a question, to inquire
definitions.explanation: To pose a question to someone in order to obtain information or clarification.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{質問|しつもん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: May I ask the teacher a question?

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧{質問|しつもん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.notes: Common phrase used after presentations or lectures

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧{質問|しつもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He asked a sharp question at the press conference.

notes:
{質問|しつもん}する means to ask a question or inquire. The noun ⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧ combines with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form the verb.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {質問|しつもん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧: to answer a question
- {質問|しつもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive questions
- {質問|しつもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げかける→投げかける：28968_nagekakeru⟧: to pose a question
- {質問|しつもん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a question
- ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧{質問|しつもん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: any questions?

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to ask (casual, everyday)
- ⟦{尋|たず}ねる→尋ねる：01175_tazuneru⟧: to inquire (slightly formal)
- ⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧: to make an inquiry (business/customer service)

NOTE:
{質問|しつもん}する is neutral in register and works in both casual and formal contexts.
